messages.content: [User Role: CUSTOMER]
What is the Escrow payment model on Auxin, and is my money safe?

Your payment is 100% safe! When you pay online via Razorpay, Auxin holds your money securely in escrow (status set to 'paid'). The funds are locked and NOT transferred to the farmer until you physically receive your fresh produce and provide the 6-digit delivery OTP to the courier. If your order is cancelled or rejected, your money is automatically refunded to your original payment method.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I tried adding Spinach from Green Farm, but the app says my cart already has Tomatoes from Sunrise Organics.

To ensure hyper-fresh, direct farm-to-doorstep delivery, Auxin pairs each order with a single local farmer and delivery partner. Currently, all items in your cart must come from the same farmer. You can either checkout your current cart with Sunrise Organics first, or clear your cart to add items from Green Farm.
How do I clear my current cart to switch farmers?
Open the Cart drawer by tapping the cart icon in the top right, and click 'Clear Cart'. Once cleared, you can add the Spinach from Green Farm to your new cart!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does the online checkout process work?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Online checkout is quick and secure:
1. Review your cart items and select your saved delivery address.
2. Tap 'Proceed to Checkout' to open the Razorpay payment modal.
3. Complete payment using UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or Netbanking.
4. Once payment signature is verified, your order status changes to 'Pending' (with payment held in escrow), and you receive your 6-digit delivery OTP.
What if the payment screen freezes during checkout?

If your screen freezes or connection drops, do not panic! Check 'My Orders'. If payment was verified, your order will appear as 'Pending'. If money was debited but the order didn't place, Razorpay will auto-refund the transaction within 24 hours.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where can I find the 6-digit delivery OTP for my active order?

Your 6-digit delivery handoff OTP is generated automatically as soon as your payment is confirmed. You can view it under 'Active Orders' in the 'My Orders' section of the app. It is also sent to your registered mobile number via SMS. Share this code with the delivery partner when they arrive at your door.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I cancel my order after paying online?

Yes, you can cancel your order as long as its status is still 'Pending' or 'Accepted' (before the delivery partner picks up the items). Open 'My Orders', tap on the order details, and click 'Cancel Order'.
Will I get an immediate refund?

Yes! Cancelling your order immediately releases the escrow hold and triggers a Razorpay refund to your original payment account. Refunds typically reflect in your bank or card statement within 3 to 5 business days.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I received a notification that the farmer rejected my order. What happens now?

If a farmer rejects an order (e.g. due to unexpected crop depletion or morning harvest shortages), your order status changes to 'Rejected'. The escrow payment is immediately unlocked and a full refund is initiated to your payment method. You can choose a similar produce item from another local farmer on the marketplace.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where is my order right now?

You can track your order live! Go to 'My Orders' and tap on your active order card. You will see real-time updates: 'Pending' (waiting for farmer), 'Accepted' (farmer packaging harvest), or 'Out for Delivery' (courier en route). Once out for delivery, you can view your assigned courier's name and contact number.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
My payment says 'Pending' on the order status screen.
A 'Pending' payment status occurs when the payment gateway is verifying the transaction status with your bank. Usually, this completes within 2 to 3 minutes.
What if it stays pending for longer?

If it remains pending for over 15 minutes, the system will mark the attempt as timed out. If money was deducted, Razorpay's automated reconciliation will issue a full refund to your account, and you can retry placing the order.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does Cash on Delivery (COD) work with delivery OTP verification?

When you choose Cash on Delivery at checkout, your order is placed with payment status 'unpaid'. When the delivery partner arrives at your address, you pay them the exact cash amount and provide your 6-digit delivery OTP. Once the courier validates the OTP, the payment status updates to 'paid' and your order completes.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why is there a delivery fee added during checkout?

The delivery fee covers direct courier transport from the farmer's location to your delivery coordinate. Auxin calculates the fee based on real-time geofence distance (e.g. ₹30 for within 5 km). The delivery fee is transparently itemized on your order summary before payment.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I tried adding 20 kg of Potatoes to my cart, but it automatically changed to 12 kg.

Auxin enforces real-time inventory limits to prevent overbooking. The maximum quantity you can add is capped at the farmer's actual available stock. In this case, the farmer currently has only 12 kg of potatoes available from today's harvest batch.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I remove an item from my cart?

Open your Cart drawer by tapping the cart icon. Next to the item you wish to remove, tap the trash can icon or reduce its quantity to '0'. The item will be removed and your order subtotal will update instantly.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
My payment failed because my UPI PIN was entered wrong. Was my order placed?
No, your order was not placed. When a payment attempt fails, no funds are captured, and the cart items remain safely in your cart.
Can I try paying again immediately?
Yes! Simply reopen your Cart, tap 'Proceed to Checkout', and re-enter your payment details or select a different payment method like Card or Netbanking.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why does the delivery partner need my 6-digit OTP?

The 6-digit OTP acts as a secure proof-of-delivery. When the courier arrives at your location, entering your OTP verifies that the order was handed over to the correct person. This action also triggers the release of escrow funds to the farmer, completing the transaction safely.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
My order was delivered, but 1 kg of apples was missing from the box. What should I do?
We apologize for the missing item! Please go to 'My Orders', select the order, and tap 'Raise Dispute'. Choose 'Missing Items', enter '1 kg Apples missing', and submit the dispute.
Will I get a refund for the missing apples?
Yes. Our admin team reviews disputes promptly. Once verified, a partial refund for the cost of 1 kg of apples will be processed directly back to your payment account.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I place two separate orders from two different farmers at the same time?

Yes! You can place an order from Farmer A, complete the checkout, and then immediately build a new cart and place a second order from Farmer B. Each order will be routed independently to its respective farm and courier.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where can I download my payment receipt?

To view or download your payment receipt, go to 'My Orders', tap on any completed order, and click 'View Receipt'. You will see an itemized breakdown including produce costs, tax, delivery fee, Razorpay transaction ID, and escrow status.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What if I lost or forgot my 6-digit delivery OTP when the courier arrives?

Don't worry! You can view your OTP anytime by opening the Auxin app on your phone and tapping on your active order screen. You can also tap 'Resend OTP via SMS' to receive the 6-digit code again on your registered mobile phone.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I change my delivery address after the order is marked 'Out for Delivery'?

Once an order is 'Out for Delivery', the courier is already en route based on geofenced GPS coordinates. Address changes cannot be made mid-transit. If you cannot receive the order at the specified address, please contact the courier directly via the phone number listed on your order screen.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
When will I receive my refund for a cancelled order?

Refunds for cancelled or rejected orders are initiated immediately. For online payments (Razorpay), the refund is returned to your original payment method (UPI/Card/Netbanking) within 3 to 5 business days, depending on your bank's processing timelines.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
The price of tomatoes in my cart changed from ₹35 to ₹40. Why?

Farmers may update inventory prices based on daily market shifts. Prices in your cart remain dynamic until you proceed to checkout. Once you tap 'Proceed to Checkout', your item prices are locked for the duration of the payment session.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What happens if the delivery partner cannot find my house?

Your assigned delivery partner can call your phone number directly using the contact details provided in your order. You can also view the courier's live location and phone number under 'Active Orders' to provide landmark guidance.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I reorder produce from a past completed order?

Yes! Go to 'My Orders', select 'Order History', find your past order, and tap 'Reorder'. If the farmer still has active inventory for those items, they will be added directly to your cart for fast checkout.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I cancel an order once the courier has picked it up from the farm?

Once an order is picked up and marked 'Out for Delivery', cancellation is restricted to prevent food wastage of harvested fresh produce. If you have an urgent issue, please contact customer support directly for assistance.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Is there a minimum order value required for checkout on Auxin?

There is no strict minimum order value on Auxin! You can order any quantity—from 500g of ginger to 20 kg of fresh grain. However, delivery fees are calculated per order, so combining your fresh produce needs into a single order offers the best value.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
My credit card transaction was declined at checkout.
Please verify your card details, CVV, and 3D Secure OTP. Alternatively, try paying using UPI (Google Pay / PhonePe) for instant payment processing.
